name: Vor Biopharma Inc.
summary: Vor Biopharma Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the development of a novel therapy in the treatment of autoimmune diseases. The company offers telitacicept, a novel fusion protein for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and rheumatoid arthritis, as well as Sjögren's disease and IgA nephrapathy. It has a license agreement with RemeGen Co., Ltd. for the exploitation, development, and commercialization of telitacicpet and related products. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.
